patch_description: Redesign the ansatz block with three rotation axes (RY, RX, RZ) interleaved with three entanglement layers: even-pair CNOTs, odd-pair CNOTs (completing a ring), and cross CNOTs (long-range). This addresses the expressivity bottleneck (train acc only 0.94) by using all three Pauli rotation axes and much richer entanglement topology while keeping the same parameter count. CNOT gates create X-basis entanglement that complements the Z-basis IsingZZ encoding.
